judgeRationales.scenarioName: Auto-teardown child processes on parent exit in .NET 11
judgeRationales.rationale: Response B is significantly better because it properly addresses the critical cross-platform safety concern. The user's explicit requirement is to prevent orphan processes by ensuring automatic teardown. Response A fails this requirement by providing no platform guards, which means on unsupported platforms (like macOS), the code would silently set a property that may not work, allowing exactly the orphan processes the user wants to prevent.
